text:
I have adapted our "Stealth" pitch to fit their strict format while keeping the "Nerd Bait" hook.
Stealth PropTech Startup | Boston, MA (or Remote) | Founding Full-Stack Engineer | CONTRACT TO HIRE | Competitive Market Rate + Equity
We are looking for a "Mad Scientist" engineer to build a living, gamified dashboard that disrupts a massive legacy industry (Consumer Logistics/Real Estate).
The Stack: React, Next.js, Supabase, Node.js. (Bonus: Framer Motion/GSAP).
The Project:
This isn't a CRUD app. It is a "Command Center" that feels like a video game. It features a dynamic "AI Companion" (Nook) that actively coaches users through complex financial and logistical phases. We need someone who can take a "Frankenstein" MVP concept and turn it into a high-performance, secure, living organism.
About You:
* You treat your IDE like a video game.
* You obsess over micro-interactions and "game feel."
* You want to be Employee #1 on a product that solves a universal anxiety point for 40k+ users in Boston alone.
The Deal:
* Mode: Contract-to-hire. We start with the MVP build (paid project). If you survive the mission, you become the Founding Engineer.
* Culture: No Jira. No PMs. Just code and shipping.
To Apply:
Email me at jobroplus@gmail.com
Do NOT send a resume. Send ONE link to the coolest/weirdest thing you have ever built. Show me code with a soul.
